summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader without running anything, per the instructions. Changes: new monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (load_decathalon_datalist plus private _resolve_path, imports only os and json); explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py; "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with one autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst; new tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist and four tests (test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, test_seg_no_labels). Unverified: tests were not run, and black/flake8 were not run. I only checked that no new line exceeds 120 columns. Choices to review: base_dir is typed as `str = None` rather than Optional, to avoid importing typing; invalid JSON surfaces as json.JSONDecodeError, a ValueError subclass; a non-object top level or non-list key value raises ValueError. Nothing was committed.
